what: Ram Charge + Rocket Salvo one-shots a full Arcanist
detail: Ram 400 kinetic + 3 x 180 rockets = 940 raw vs Arcanist 380/500: DOWN. The judge required fix (Arcanist 500 or Ram x0.75 vs ships) is only half applied (500 but Ram unscaled vs ships); use RAM_VS_SHIP 0.625 as Sortie does.

what: Ram Charge + Rocket Salvo one-shots a full Arcanist
detail: Ram 400 kinetic + 3 x 180 rockets = 940 raw vs Arcanist 380/420: DOWN. The judge required fix (Arcanist 500 or Ram x0.75 vs ships) is not applied (420, Ram 400); use RAM_VS_SHIP 0.625 as Sortie does.

what: Room-clear bonus wording
detail: "+6% for each live party pilot" read as x6 = +36% per room per pilot -> 11.0 vs 8.0 ults/10 min on floor 1 (38% more). Pin it to +6% per pilot.

what: Gravity Well (E) traps the Jugg
detail: the E well pulls hostile ships at the full well pull (live stepWell, uniform): base 900 px/s^2 for 3 s lets out after 2.13 s the Jugg; Void + Deep Well (1350, r364, 5 s) holds it the whole 5 s even boosting (CR Jugg thrust 620, x1.5 boost = 930). A 6.5-10 s-cooldown SPECIAL out-pulls the Event Horizon ultimate (260-300 on ships). Cap well ship pull at ~300 or apply Sortie's SHIP_PULL_CAP.

what: Gravity Well (E) traps the Dreadnought n3
detail: the E well pulls hostile ships at the full well pull (live stepWell, uniform): base 900 px/s^2 for 3 s holds the Dreadnought n3; Void + Deep Well (1350, r364, 5 s) holds it the whole 5 s even boosting (CR Jugg thrust 620, x1.5 boost = 930). A 6.5-10 s-cooldown SPECIAL out-pulls the Event Horizon ultimate (260-300 on ships). Cap well ship pull at ~300 or apply Sortie's SHIP_PULL_CAP.

what: Polarize sustain alone is power-positive
detail: L1 sustain (no gun): 280 regen - 40 thrust - 200 = +40/s (+80 parked), so it never ends off-fire; under sustained fire the free shield regen (170/s x 0.6 power) makes it -62/s -> 16.1 s of 0.5 hardening, kamikaze-proof shell and shield regen while tanking. The judge's 140 -> 200 fix only bites while shooting; count the sustain as 2 load or 260/s.

what: Permanent Gravity Well
detail: Void path (cd 6.5 s) + voi_horizon (+2 s) + Flux Core 4: 1.2 wells alive on average (100% uptime) - a standing 280-360 px pull zone; cap wells at 1 alive or make Deep Well +1 s.

what: Permanent Shield Wall (Architect)
detail: 2 charges at 7 s each + Flux Core 4 -> 1.3 walls standing on average (100% of the time at least one 2400-hp wall, Reinforced ones reflect lasers). Hero/Sortie walls sit at 57% / 50% base.

what: FULL STOP slower than counter-thrust (Jugg)
detail: Arcade Kit Jugg: FULL STOP 0.77 s / 149 px but reversing thrust stops in 0.67 s / 138 px: the new brake is a trap on this hull (raise stopDecel to >= thrust - brake).

what: Ram Charge dominates Arti's signature Overdrive as an escape
detail: mean EHP taken in the 8 s chase 38% vs 61% and no worse against any pursuer: the "sidegrade" is a strict escape upgrade on this hull (the signature keeps only its damage/heal).

what: Warp dominates Arti's signature Overdrive as an escape
detail: mean EHP taken in the 8 s chase 33% vs 61% and no worse against any pursuer: the "sidegrade" is a strict escape upgrade on this hull (the signature keeps only its damage/heal).

what: Pip gravity roughly doubles passive XP pickup
detail: fly-by collection width 471 px vs today's 238 px (1.98x) before any Magnet card; Magnet L5 980 px, Tractor 1176 px. Levels (and the level-3 path / ult unlocks) arrive earlier; re-pin the XP curve or trim the base well.

what: Artificer LMB+RMB never browns out
detail: Arcade Kit Artificer (420/s reactor) holds Phaser + Deploy Sentry indefinitely (net 66/s over the first 2 s).

what: Artificer Phaser + Ray sustainable
detail: Phaser + E-hold Ray (L2, 170/s) never browns out in 30 s (net -22/s): the 420/s reactor still funds endless heal-while-shooting.

what: Ult chain "EMP -> 2 Hyperlance rails" takes down 2+ classes from full
detail: 0/120 / DOWN / DOWN (Jugg / Arca / Arti). EMP-type ults are the enabler; with ~10-12 ults/min on a 16-ship map, a coordinated pair lands every few seconds somewhere.

what: Ult chain "EMP -> Wrecking Run (1 hit + shock)" takes down 2+ classes from full
detail: 0/360 / DOWN / DOWN (Jugg / Arca / Arti). EMP-type ults are the enabler; with ~10-12 ults/min on a 16-ship map, a coordinated pair lands every few seconds somewhere.

what: Ult chain "EMP -> Carpet Bomb (parked)" takes down 2+ classes from full
detail: 0/438 / DOWN / DOWN (Jugg / Arca / Arti). EMP-type ults are the enabler; with ~10-12 ults/min on a 16-ship map, a coordinated pair lands every few seconds somewhere.

what: EMP Pulse is un-counterable inside its radius
detail: r420 with a 0.35 s tell: from the centre nobody can leave (needs ~1200 px/s). It zeroes shields, drains 40% power and blocks regen 2 s; a point-blank Jugg MD then takes an Arcanist down in 0.58 s. Counterplay is only pre-emptive spacing; consider r340 (Arcade/Sortie) or a 0.6 s tell.

what: Hyperlance spool can track
detail: Spool 0.45 s along the live aim: a Juggernaut at rest needs 0.58 s (reaction + 34 px of thrust) to leave a locked line, and nothing can leave a tracking one. Lock the rail direction at spool start (or turn-rate cap ~1 rad/s) so "react to the line" is real counterplay.

what: Drone Carrier counterplay fails
detail: "shoot the drones": Arca LZ is taken down at 1.8 s while clearing (7.2 s to clear); Arti PH is taken down at 2.6 s while clearing (6.7 s to clear). 6 drones = 540 kinetic dps within 550 px for 10 s, i.e. a second point-blank Mass Driver that auto-aims. Cut drone dps vs ships (x0.4) or drone count to 4.

what: Wrecking Run re-hit loop
detail: Impacts allow one hit per target per 0.5 s and stagger lasts 0.6 s; at 900 px/s and turn 6 rad/s the run loops back in ~1.05 s (150 px radius), so a staggered target is hit 2-3 times in the 3 s run: 2 hits + shockwave take down a full Arcanist, 3 hits a full Artificer (the spec checks only 1 hit). Make it once per target per run (or stagger 0.3 s).

what: Event Horizon owner is the glass cannon
detail: Hero puts the ship-centred black hole on the Arcanist (380/420): parked alone it eats ~21.0 kamikaze contacts in 5 s (1186 dmg on floor 3, 148% of its EHP) plus the pulled swarm; the other two kits give EH to the Juggernaut (armor 0.4 + Polarize).

what: Hero Carpet Bomb clears 67% of a floor-3 pulse alone
detail: hpScale-relative damage keeps this true on every floor: with ~5 party ults/min a 6-pilot party can delete most pulses without weapons; re-run riftParity with ults on.

detail: Hero/Arcade/Sortie all count Space-held FULL STOP in L; a parked pilot holding Space is strained (regen x0.85, surcharge x1.25) for no benefit. Count it only while |v| > 5 px/s.

what: Flux Core pushes ults under the "never under ~52 s" promise
detail: all gains x1.2 -> 39 s shortest gap for a top pilot (floor 59.4 / 1.2 = 49.5 s).

what: Ult castable in brownout
detail: Q ignores brownout (only EMP blocks it): brown out on purpose, then ult. Hero and Sortie block Q in brownout.

what: Event Horizon: kamikazes reach the hull
detail: crush 900/s kills a drone in 0.18 s but it crosses the 57 px band in 0.13 s; elites x3 HP always reach the hull.

what: Warp is a total escape from MD/Phaser pursuers
detail: the Arcanist takes 0% from a chasing Jugg MD or Arti Phaser after one Warp (cd 5 s < every MD/Phaser TTK); only Lasers (1265 px) punish it. Intended class identity, but combine with the shield-delay trim and the loop is: Warp, stop boosting, full shield in ~2.2 s.

what: Warp cycles inside a Laser TTK (Jugg)
detail: effective cd 6.0 s vs Laser TTK 7.9 s at 600 px: 1.3 i-frame uses per duel.

what: Charge during an active ult is unspecified
detail: Sortie only stops the PASSIVE while an ult runs; pending (incl. the ult's own damage) keeps filling and draining. Harmless in Arena (pending cap 400, rate 12/s floor 49 s) but state it: "no source points while ult-active; ult damage never charges".

what: Ultimate Core breaks the 49 s Arena floor
detail: x1.3 on passive + points with the fixed 12/s drain: floor 1000/(8.5 x 1.3 + 12) = 43 s; model shortest gap 44 s. Scale the drain too or cap the card at x1.15.

what: Rampage contact cap
detail: contacts limited to once per 0.5 s per target -> up to 10 x 160 = 1600 raw on one ship in 5 s while CC-immune; 3 contacts leave a full Arcanist at 0/494 but 5+ take it down. Cap at 3 hits per target per run (like Carpet Bomb).

what: pveScale cap 4 bites from Veteran floor 6 / Nightmare floor 3
detail: Ults (and R items) lose 10-45% of their relative power exactly where the Geometry Wars ramp peaks; either lift the cap to 6 or accept that late floors need weapons more.
